meta.notes: The border crossing at night, for two men sneaking. Its one idea: two lane men who watch each other along a seized container on the kerb, each with his back to the dark lot — nobody crosses the lane until both drop on one word. Also: a boom man watching the lit west crossing from his hut, a locked fence door under a battery camera at the east end, a blast screen across the far mouth of the lane, a customs house of three rooms north of the road, a lot and the generator shed south of it. Seven beats authored, five or six manned a deal. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts crossing

coffee.name: the kettle in the boom hut

response.why: A border post: the company that mans it sleeps in its lines up the road, with a duty section dressed and a telephone to the customs house.
